notes: The final full matrix is construction-results.json. Earlier conditional-write runs are superseded and retained to explain the investigation.
The retained focused experiment was measured as a dirty working tree at d232367; its unconditional base-write adjustment was then committed as dd457ef.
The identical-source control compares d232367 with itself. It bounds variation for that precursor; it does not establish zero regression for the final source.
Cold measurements use a separate one-off production build without the React fixture, fresh pages, detached Frames, and precise isolated-context timers; no layout or paint.
Cold diagnostic script was /tmp/framekit-cold.mjs; unlike run.mjs this one-off script is not a maintained benchmark entry point.

coldFinal.methodology: 31 fresh pages per version; alternating order. First default Frame, then first article Frame, then 100 warm create/destroy lifetimes. Detached, no layout or paint. Cross-origin isolation for precise timers. Includes JIT cold paths.
